SELECT
    e.equipmentcode AS Equipment,
    ce.heaterstatus AS "Heater Status",
    tswg.insulationstatus AS "Insulation Status",
    las.emergencylightstatus AS "Emergency Light Status",
    ws.structuralloadpercent AS "Structure Load",
    om.operationalstatus AS "Readiness Label"
FROM
    equipment e
JOIN
    cabinenvironment ce ON e.equipmentcode = ce.cabineqref
JOIN
    thermalsolarwindandgrid tswg ON e.equipmentcode = tswg.thermaleqref
JOIN
    lightingandsafety las ON e.equipmentcode = las.lighteqref
JOIN
    location l ON e.equipmentcode = l.loceqref
JOIN
    weatherandstructure ws ON l.locationregistry = ws.weatherlocref
JOIN
    operationmaintenance om ON e.equipmentcode = om.opmainteqref
WHERE
    ws.structuralintegritystatus = 'Normal';

    e.equipmentcode AS equipment,
    ce.heaterstatus AS heater_status,
    tswg.insulationstatus AS insulation_status,
    las.emergencylightstatus AS emergency_light_status,
    ws.structuralloadpercent AS structure_margin,
    om.operationalstatus AS readiness_label
FROM
    equipment e
JOIN
    cabinenvironment ce ON e.equipmentcode = ce.cabineqref
JOIN
    thermalsolarwindandgrid tswg ON e.equipmentcode = tswg.thermaleqref
JOIN
    lightingandsafety las ON e.equipmentcode = las.lighteqref
JOIN
    location l ON e.equipmentcode = l.loceqref
JOIN
    weatherandstructure ws ON l.locationregistry = ws.weatherlocref
JOIN
    operationmaintenance om ON e.equipmentcode = om.opmainteqref
WHERE
    ce.heaterstatus = 'On'
    AND tswg.insulationstatus = 'Good'
    AND las.emergencylightstatus = 'On'
    AND ws.structuralintegritystatus = 'Normal'
    AND om.operationalstatus = 'Active';

WITH panel_age AS (
    SELECT 
        DATE_PART('year', AGE(CURRENT_DATE, initdate)) AS age,
        COUNT(*) AS panel_count
    FROM 
        plant
    GROUP BY 
        age
),
performance_metrics AS (
    SELECT 
        DATE_PART('year', AGE(CURRENT_DATE, pl.initdate)) AS age,
        AVG((efficiency_profile -> 'current_efficiency' ->> 'curreffpct')::NUMERIC) AS avg_efficiency
    FROM 
        performance AS pe
    JOIN 
        panel AS p ON pe.solmodref = p.panemark
    JOIN 
        plant AS pl ON p.hubregistry = pl.growregistry
    GROUP BY 
        age
)

    pa.age AS panel_age,
    pm.avg_efficiency,
    pa.panel_count
FROM 
    panel_age AS pa
JOIN 
    performance_metrics AS pm ON pa.age = pm.age
ORDER BY 
    pa.age;

WITH panel_age AS (
    SELECT 
        panemark,
        EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM pl.initdate) AS age
    FROM 
        panel p
    JOIN 
        plant pl ON p.hubregistry = pl.growregistry
),
age_ranges AS (
    SELECT 
        panemark, 
        CASE 
            WHEN age < 5 THEN '0-5' 
            WHEN age >= 5 AND age < 10 THEN '5-10' 
            WHEN age >= 10 AND age < 15 THEN '10-15' 
            ELSE '15+' 
        END AS age_range, 
        age
    FROM 
        panel_age
),
performance_metrics AS (
    SELECT 
        solmodref AS panemark, 
        JSONB_EXTRACT_PATH_TEXT(efficiency_profile, 'current_efficiency', 'curreffpct')::NUMERIC AS curreffpct
    FROM 
        performance
),
panel_performance AS (
    SELECT 
        ar.panemark, 
        ar.age_range, 
        ar.age,
        pm.curreffpct
    FROM 
        age_ranges ar
    JOIN 
        performance_metrics pm ON ar.panemark = pm.panemark
)
SELECT 
    age_range, 
    AVG(curreffpct) AS avg_curreffpct, 
    COUNT(DISTINCT panemark) AS num_panels
FROM 
    panel_performance
GROUP BY 
    age_range
ORDER BY 
    age_range;

SELECT 
    f.userregistry AS fan_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT i.interactidolpivot) AS idol_count
FROM 
    fans f
JOIN 
    interactions i ON f.userregistry = i.interactfanpivot
GROUP BY 
    f.userregistry
HAVING 
    COUNT(DISTINCT i.interactidolpivot) > 1
ORDER BY 
    idol_count DESC;
right:
SELECT 
    f.userregistry AS fan_id,
    f.nicklabel AS fan_nickname,
    COUNT(DISTINCT i.interactidolpivot) AS number_of_idols,
    STRING_AGG(vi.nametag, ', ') AS idol_names,
    AVG(e.engrate) AS average_engagement
FROM 
    fans f
JOIN 
    interactions i ON f.userregistry = i.interactfanpivot
JOIN 
    virtualidols vi ON i.interactidolpivot = vi.entityreg
JOIN 
    engagement e ON i.interactfanpivot = e.engagememberpivot
GROUP BY 
    f.userregistry, f.nicklabel
HAVING 
    COUNT(DISTINCT i.interactidolpivot) > 1
ORDER BY 
    number_of_idols DESC, average_engagement DESC;

    SELECT 
        i.interactfanpivot AS fan_id,

    SELECT 
        f.userregistry AS user_id,

        fic.idol_count,
        STRING_AGG(vi.nametag, ', ') AS idol_names,
        AVG(e.socintscore) AS avg_engagement
    FROM 
        fans f

        FanIdolCounts fic ON f.userregistry = fic.fan_id

        interactions i ON f.userregistry = i.interactfanpivot

        fic.idol_count > 1

        f.userregistry, f.nicklabel, fic.idol_count
)

    idol_count,

    avg_engagement
